:::{#def-cind}
#### Conditional independence

Random variables $\dsn{Y}$ are **conditionally independent**
[@wikipedia_conditional_independence]
given a discrete random variable (or vector) $\vX$
if, for every value $\vx$ with $\Pr(\vX = \vx) > 0$
and all sets of real numbers $\dsn{A}$,
the conditional probability that every $Y_i$ falls in its set
is the product of the individual conditional probabilities:

$$\Pr(Y_1 \in A_1, \ldots, Y_n \in A_n \mid \vX = \vx) = \prodin{\Pr(Y_i \in A_i \mid \vX = \vx)}$$

:::
